messages:
Liz: quick sync — want to lock the rollout decision matrix for this release. need green on SLA/backstop, docs, support ops, pricing. can we call out gaps now?
Ben: +1. quick question — target SLO? 99.9 or 99.95 for GA?
Eva: pricing note: we need final unit rates and reserved-cap discount policy before GA. draft table in the doc: https://go/release-pricing-draft (please review).
Carla: support ops: runbooks + escalation matrix are missing. oncall can cover first-line 9-5, but we need pager handoff for nights. retention/detail for traces? 30d ok?
Dan: docs: we need quickstart, migration guide, and a Known Limitations / regressions section. can deliver first pass by EOD Wed.
Frank: infra: canary + automated rollback must be in place. we also need explicit circuit-breaker behavior documented. currently missing remediation playbook.
Liz: propose decision matrix rows = [SLO, docs, runbooks, billing, monitoring, rollbacks]; columns = [must-have, stretch, blocked]. my pick: monitoring = must-have, rollbacks = must-have, billing = must-have.
Ben: technical checklist: model-variant fallback, KV-cache warmup, rate-limit backpressure, circuit-breakers. snippet for fallback policy: ```route_policy:
  fallback: smaller-model
  retries: 2
```
DeployBot: scheduled deploy to staging in 15 minutes for canary testing. :rocket:
Carla: support will draft runbook template and escalation matrix. plan training session for support next Tue.
Eva: billing contact is @eva-billing. proposed pricing rules: usage tiers + reserved capacity discount + overage rate. need final table by Fri to publish docs.
Liz: action items: Ben -> implement fallback + CB by Thu; Frank -> rollback playbook by Thu; Dan -> docs + migration guide by Wed EOD; Carla -> runbook draft by Thu + training session; Eva -> finalize pricing table by Fri. If all green, target GA cut Mon. :white_check_mark:
Ben: ack, will slot tasks in sprint.
Dan: adding GH tasks now: https://go/gh/issue/12345 (docs + examples).
Carla: noted, will share runbook PR when ready.
Liz: thanks — i'll update the matrix in Asana and follow up on blockers.
